summary: A Starship delivery robot on an Arizona university campus reportedly reversed into a university employee, knocked her down, and moved toward her again while she was on the ground. She had a back injury and an arm cut; the company offered promo codes and insurance details.
technical_summary: A semi-autonomous sidewalk delivery robot suddenly changed direction and reversed into a pedestrian who had passed behind it, then reversed again toward the person on the ground. The company said it moved at very low speed after detecting an oncoming vehicle, indicating a perception or planning error near people.

summary: Canada's tax agency chatbot, Charlie, gave correct answers to only 2 of 6 test questions in an Auditor General audit, while other public AI tools answered 5 of 6 correctly. The tool remains live and has handled millions of conversations.
technical_summary: A government-built conversational AI for tax questions, later upgraded to generative AI, produced frequently inaccurate and limited responses in audit testing. The agency cannot determine its actual accuracy without reviewing transcripts, so errors reach users at scale without systematic monitoring.

sector.quote: The Canada Revenue Agency is facing renewed scrutiny after the Auditor General found its taxpayer-funded chatbot frequently delivers incorrect answers

technology.quote: the exact number of questions the Generative Artificial Intelligence chatbot has answered correctly cannot be precisely determined

failure_mode.quote: We found that Charlie provided accurate answers in only 2 out of the 6 questions we asked it

harm_type.quote: repeatedly gave out the wrong information to Canadians trying to file their taxes

affected_population.quote: repeatedly gave out the wrong information to Canadians trying to file their taxes

notes: Audit sample was small (six questions); agency cites a 70 percent internal accuracy threshold. Figures need primary-source verification.

summary: A fake video circulating on Facebook appeared to show UK Labour leader Keir Starmer promoting an investment scheme. Fact-checkers found the audio had been altered with AI and his office confirmed it was not genuine.
technical_summary: A voice-cloned audio track was laid over real footage from a 2023 address, with visible lip-sync flaws and unnatural pronunciation of currency. The clip, captioned as a government initiative, was used to lend credibility to an investment scam.

summary: In the first weeks of the war in Iran, large numbers of AI-generated fake images and videos of nonexistent attacks, destruction and captured soldiers spread on social media and messaging apps and were viewed millions of times.
technical_summary: Low-cost generative image and video tools let nearly anyone produce lifelike war scenes. Journalists identified over 110 unique fakes using watermarks and detectors. Platform design that favors engagement helped spread them, and some were reportedly used as informational weapons.

sector.quote: A torrent of fake videos and images generated by artificial intelligence have overrun social networks during the first weeks of the war in Iran.

technology.quote: A sophisticated new wave of A.I. tools makes the fakes possible, enabling nearly anyone to create lifelike simulations of war

failure_mode.quote: The content has become a potent informational weapon for Tehran

harm_type.quote: The New York Times identified over 110 unique A.I.-generated images and videos from the past two weeks about the war in the Middle East.

notes: Mix of state-linked, engagement-driven and satirical content; counts and view figures come from news outlets and need verification.

summary: Advertisers reported that Meta's AI-driven Advantage Plus ad tool burned through daily budgets in hours with sharply higher costs per impression and little revenue, hurting small businesses. They also criticized Meta's lack of transparency.
technical_summary: An automated, AI-enabled shopping-campaign system with opaque optimization overspent caps and delivered few sales, with behavior varying unpredictably day to day. Advertisers had little visibility into the cause or accountability, as the product was marketed as set-it-and-forget-it.

sector.quote: Small businesses have seen their ad dollars get wiped out and wasted as a result

failure_mode.quote: automated ad platform has been blowing through budgets and failing to deliver sales

notes: Based on marketers' accounts; Meta's explanation is not in the excerpt.

summary: Reports of at least 100 malfunctions and adverse events, including at least 10 injuries, have followed the addition of AI to a sinus surgery navigation system, which allegedly misreported instrument positions. Two patients who suffered strokes sued; the makers deny a causal link.
technical_summary: A machine-learning feature added to a surgical navigation device is alleged to have given surgeons inaccurate instrument location inside patients' heads, contributing to artery and skull-base injuries. Regulatory reports cannot establish causation, and lawsuits allege rushed integration with a low accuracy target.

sector.quote: added artificial intelligence to a medical device used to treat chronic sinusitis

technology.quote: would now use a machine-learning algorithm to assist ear, nose and throat specialists in surgeries

summary: Two tourists in Peru reportedly relied on an AI-generated itinerary for a canyon that does not exist, paying to reach a rural road with no guide or destination. A local trekking operator warned that such errors are dangerous at altitude.
technical_summary: A chatbot combined the names of two unrelated places into a confident, detailed description of a nonexistent destination. Without cross-checking, travelers made paid arrangements to reach it, illustrating hallucinated travel information in high-altitude terrain where planning errors carry safety risks.

technology.quote: travellers are increasingly using tools like ChatGPT for itinerary ideas

failure_mode.quote: and being sent to destinations that don't exist

harm_type.quote: The tourist paid nearly $160 (£118) in order to get to a rural road in the environs of Mollepata
This sort of misinformation is perilous in Peru

notes: The physical harm is a warned risk, not an injury; the specific chatbot is not named for this case in the excerpts.

summary: The National Republican Senatorial Committee released an attack ad with an AI-generated video of Senator Chuck Schumer repeating a real quote about the government shutdown. The ad carried AI labels, but observers warned it crossed a new line in political advertising.
technical_summary: Synthetic video and audio created a realistic version of a senator speaking words he had only said in print, never on camera. A watermark and platform labels disclosed the AI origin, yet critics said fabricated footage of a real person erodes trust in authentic political content.

summary: A political action committee aired an AI-generated ad portraying a US senator running for governor as taking pharmaceutical payments in exchange for legislation. Her lawyers called the bribery claims defamatory and the ad was pulled by a cable provider.
technical_summary: Generative video, likely with an AI-made jingle, created absurd synthetic scenes and a likeness of the senator in a spoof drug commercial. Its bribery allegations and the state's synthetic-media disclosure law prompted legal threats over defamation and disclosure compliance.

summary: Researchers showed that the GPT-2 language model memorized and could be prompted to reproduce personal information from its training data, such as names, phone numbers and email addresses. OpenAI later worked on a filter to block such outputs.
technical_summary: Large language models can memorize rare training snippets. By sampling many generations and keeping those with unusually high likelihood, researchers extracted verbatim text including contact details and identifiers, even from items appearing once in training data. Larger models were more vulnerable.

sector.quote: In our recent paper, we evaluate how large language models memorize and regurgitate such rare snippets of their training data.

technology.quote: GPT-2, a language model trained on scrapes of the public Internet

failure_mode.quote: These extracted examples include (public) personally identifiable information (names, phone numbers, and email addresses)
an adversary can perform a training data extraction attack to recover individual training examples by querying the language model

notes: A research demonstration of a risk; no harm to specific individuals is reported.
